# SEODilated

> SEODilated is an SEO agency specialising in guest posts, manual link building and search visibility across SEO, AEO (Answer Engine Optimization) and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization). Every placement is on a real, vetted website, won through manual outreach, and delivered with a full live-link report. Delivered placements are covered by a free 60-day replacement guarantee.

## Key facts

- Led by Khuwalid Khalid, an SEO specialist with 7 years of experience in guest posting, link building and search visibility
- Semrush certified: SEO Essentials, Off-Page SEO, and AI Search Essentials (valid May 2026 to May 2027)
- Contact: contact@seodilated.com, +44 7832 367128

## How SEODilated works

- Manual outreach only. No automated link schemes, no link farms, no private blog networks.
- Human-written content for every guest post.
- Most placements are dofollow. If a publisher only allows nofollow or sponsored attributes, the client is told before the link goes live.
- Every order ends with a full live-link report: the exact URL of each placement, the page the link appears on, and the anchor text used.
- If a delivered link drops or is removed within 60 days, it is replaced free of charge with a comparable placement.
- Every enquiry starts with an honest review of the client's site. SEODilated does not promise guaranteed search rankings.

## Services

- [SEO](https://www.seodilated.com/services/seo): Full search engine optimisation: keyword research, on-page and technical fixes, and the guest posts and link building that build authority.
- [AEO](https://www.seodilated.com/services/aeo): Answer Engine Optimization: structured answer content, entity clarity and brand mentions so AI assistants and answer engines surface and cite the business.
- [GEO](https://www.seodilated.com/services/geo): Generative Engine Optimization: visibility work for AI-generated answers and overviews.
- [Complete Ecommerce Management](https://www.seodilated.com/services/complete-ecommerce-management): End-to-end management for ecommerce stores, including Amazon and eBay, with SEO built in.
- [Web Development](https://www.seodilated.com/services/web-development): Website development delivered by the same team that grows the traffic.
- [WordPress Development](https://www.seodilated.com/services/wordpress-development): WordPress builds, fixes and ongoing development.
- [Content Writing](https://www.seodilated.com/services/content-writing): Human-written content for guest posts, pages and campaigns.
- [Performance Optimization](https://www.seodilated.com/services/performance-optimization): Speed and performance work so pages load fast and hold their rankings.
